tasks.short: Respond to station problems by adjusting equipment

steps.what: Read the actual problem indications and locate the applicable response procedure
Determine the actual control-room adjustment needed under the applicable procedure
Check current operating readiness and authorize the exact intended equipment adjustment
Make the exact authorized adjustment on the actual control-room equipment
Observe and verify the actual equipment response
Write the actual operational-change entry after the adjustment and response check
Save the working change-log entry in the same system

tasks.design: Provide equipment-linked response references from {DOCS} in {OTHER}, the station control system. The operator still decides, checks current readiness, adjusts equipment, verifies the response and writes the actual change record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedure retrieval could require searching separate equipment references during a problem.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tag and procedure-version links can shorten that retrieval without controlling equipment.
tasks.still_hard: The right response depends on current conditions and consequences elsewhere in the station.
tasks.human_edge: The operator acts under the actual operating procedure and assesses the live response.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: tag-linked references can support response preparation while live equipment decisions and actions remain human.

tasks.short: Record readings and operational changes in operating logs

steps.what: Read actual instruments and identify the equipment, time, units and operational changes for logging
Transfer identified instrument values and event fields into the draft operating log
Write the actual context and explanation of operational changes
Check the complete log against actual readings, timing and change context
Save the ordinary operating-log entry in the same system

tasks.design: Populate draft log fields from the identified instrument and event records in {OTHER}, the station historian and operating-log system. The operator supplies operational context and checks the complete entry before its ordinary save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing readings and event identifiers were retyped into the operating log.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed equipment, timestamp and unit mappings can transfer exact values without interpreting events.
tasks.still_hard: An instrument value alone does not explain why an operational change occurred.
tasks.human_edge: The operator records context and distinguishes a true event from unreliable data.

ambition.what: No change to logging or operating authority.

tasks.short: Prepare and submit daily facility operating reports

steps.what: Collect the actual day's logs, operating totals and report source identifiers
Assemble selected operating totals, event references and fixed report sections
Write the actual daily operating context, exceptions and unresolved issues
Check all report totals, dates, recipients and narrative against the day's actual records
Save the final working report package in its current store
Perform the existing shift-supervisor release review on the final daily report and recipient list
Submit the exact authorized daily report package to its internal operating-report recipients

tasks.design: Configure a daily report package from selected {OTHER} operating records and a fixed {DOCS} template. Preserve factual-context writing, the operator's complete checks and the actual existing shift-supervisor release route; send the exact released package through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Daily source fields were copied into the report and its package was sent manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed report fields and an authorized-recipient route can assemble and submit a version-bound package.
tasks.still_hard: The day's exceptions need accurate operational context, not an invented machine narrative.
tasks.human_edge: The operator explains actual events and the existing release authority checks the completed report.

ambition.what: No expanded reporting or equipment authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed operating-record fields can populate a daily report and an authorized route can transmit its exact final package.
